## Which file do I need?

Cognitive Terrain runs in your web browser. Nothing to install.

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.18.1.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.18.1.pdf** |
| A one-sheet summary to print, two-sided | **Cognitive-Terrain-Player-Aid-0.18.1.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.18.1.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |

Two-player games work as long as both players use a 0.18 build (0.18.0, 0.18.1 and so on).

## What's new

- **A new screen layout.** Panels now run down both sides of the map, framed
  in the game's graphite and sand. The left side holds the mind you are
  looking at, Decision Health, budget and moves; the right side holds the
  other mind and What is happening. The map sits centred in the space between.
  Two-player codes from 0.18.0 still work: no rules changed.
- **Default or Minimal.** Settings › Screen layout. Minimal gives the map the
  whole screen and keeps only budget and moves in view; the two buttons next
  to the view tabs open the side panels. Narrow screens always use Minimal.
- **Move the map.** Drag to pan, scroll to zoom around the pointer,
  double-click or ⌖ to recentre. A short drag never plays a card by accident.
- **Their edge on you.** A new panel lists every advantage the other side has
  right now: technologies that make its moves spread further, Bot Swarm
  hitting every neighbour at full strength, your lost TRUST (its posts reach
  ten times as far, your corrections land at half strength) and moves that
  cost it less than they cost you. It also says when the next technology
  arrives.
- **Moves as a number.** Moves left this turn show as a large number with a
  diamond for each move.
- **Card colours.** Attack cards are edged in red, defence cards in blue.
- **Both health scores in the top bar**, so they stay in view in either
  layout.
- Tutorial, Field Manual (2.4, 2.5, 15.1) and Practitioner's Manual updated,
  with every picture retaken.
